data.title: Child supplement (Kinderzuschlag) application rejected
data.summary: The Familienkasse Muster-Mitte rejected your application of 6 October 2025 for child supplement (Kinderzuschlag) for October 2025 to March 2026. The reason is that your household income exceeds the maximum income limit.
data.explanation: The family benefits office has refused your child supplement (Kinderzuschlag) because the income of your household is above the upper limit. The calculation is in an attachment that is not part of this text. If you disagree, you may file an objection (Widerspruch) in writing, electronically or in person for the record at the Familienkasse. The app shows the deadline. If you do nothing, the rejection becomes final. If unsure about the calculation, consider advice from a counselling service or a specialist.
